links.outcome: Expert uncertainty recognition and explanation with versus without ConfiDx assistance
links.effect: ConfiDx-assisted experts outperformed standalone experts by 10.7% in uncertainty recognition and 26% in uncertainty explanation.
links.quote: Moreover, ConfiDx-assisted experts outperformed standalone experts by 10.7% in uncertainty recognition and 26% in uncertainty explanation, underscoring its substantial potential to improve clinical decision-making.

links.outcome: Model identification and explanation of diagnostic uncertainty on real-world datasets
links.effect: ConfiDx excelled in identifying diagnostic uncertainties and generating trustworthy explanations for diagnoses and uncertainties (no numbers in abstract).
links.quote: Evaluating on real-world datasets demonstrated that ConfiDx excelled in identifying diagnostic uncertainties, achieving superior diagnostic performance, and generating trustworthy explanations for diagnoses and uncertainties.

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning LLMs with diagnostic criteria to identify and explain diagnostic uncertainty

screen.reason: Evaluates a novel fine-tuned LLM (ConfiDx) for uncertainty-aware diagnosis and its impact on expert decision-making in reader/simulated tests.
